rows.title: Autumn
notes: “we listened to Melbourne band Big Scary with their tune called Autumn”
Track from The Big Scary Four Seasons (2010) by the Melbourne duo; also released as a 2011 single.

rows.title: Winterland
notes: “Died Pretty with Winterland, an incredible song from an incredible band”
1987/88 single by the Sydney band, from their album Lost; was one of the best-selling alternative singles of 1987.

rows.title: Girls In Their Summer Clothes (Winter Mix)
Come On Spring
notes: “we followed that with another Come On Spring song from La Luke”
'La Luke' is likely an ASR mishearing of Luluc, the Australian duo whose 2023 single 'Come On Spring' (from the album Diamonds) matches the announced title exactly.
